summary.selection: Not a random sample. These stores were assembled to be written to, so each one passed filters a random draw does not apply: it sits in a ratings-ranked band of the seller index, it publishes a contact address on its product page (about 17.5% of sellers do), its top-rated product is not free, and it has a published category page. Reported as a replication of the random sample, never as an estimate of the platform.
summary.method: Identical to the sample: two page loads per store from London, GB — the product page, then the gumroad.com/checkout URL its own buy control carries. No order completed, no form submitted, no account touched. One product per store, the most recent reading where a store was walked more than once.
